items.raw_excerpt: The British government's proposed new legacy laws give it "maximum control" over public disclosure of sensitive information and that should be changed, according to a new report.
items.summary_en: The British government's new legacy laws give it maximum control over public disclosure of sensitive information. A new report says changes are needed to these proposed laws.
items.summary_ko: 영국 정부의 새로운 시효법은 민감 정보의 공개에 대해 정부에 최대한의 통제권을 부여하고 있다. 새로운 보고서는 이러한 법안에 변화가 필요하다고 밝히고 있다.
items.title_en: Changes needed to Britain's new legacy laws - report

items.raw_excerpt: The fall season is upon us, and that means it's time for pumpkin patches, wagon rides, cozy small towns, and warm cups of spiced coffee. If you're looking for a charming spot to soak up the autumn season in Ontario, you may want to add this little waterfront town to your plans.
items.summary_en: Thornbury on Georgian Bay is a charming small town with cozy cafes and apple markets. The town offers pumpkin patches, wagon rides, and warm spiced coffee for autumn visitors. It's a perfect spot to enjoy the fall season in Ontario.
items.summary_ko: 조지아만에 위치한 썽번리는 아늑한 카페와 사과 시장이 있는 매력적인 소도시입니다. 이 마을에서는 호박밭, 마차 여행, 따뜻한 향신료 커피를 즐길 수 있습니다. 온타리오에서 가을을 보내기에 완벽한 장소입니다.
items.title_en: Cozy Ontario Waterfront Town Perfect for Fall Getaway

items.raw_excerpt: Salzburg präsentiert sich auch im Herbst als Kleinstadt von Weltformat und lockt zum Erkunden, Flanieren und Genießen.
items.summary_en: Salzburg shines in autumn as a charming city with world-class appeal. The city invites visitors to explore, stroll through colorful streets, and enjoy the season.
items.summary_ko: 살츠부르크는 가을에도 세계적 도시의 매력을 뽐낸다. 도시는 탐험하고 거리를 거닐며 계절을 만끽하도록 방문객을 초대한다.
